release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD966A-450ZK2F is a bi-spectrum cooled thermal sphere PTZ pairing a 640x512 MCT cooled MWIR thermal imager (45 to 450 mm continuous zoom) with a 2 MP 100x low-lux optical camera for long-range border, coastal and infrastructure surveillance with vessel detection, GPS positioning and perimeter VCA. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels; thermal is usually Channel 2, optical Channel 1.
